text:
Aisha: Hi everyone :wave: I’m Aisha, starting today — quick q: where’s the security training and what’s the timeline? Also I’m on a personal Mac right now — do I need to enroll it in MDM or should I request a company laptop?
Maya (People Ops): Welcome Aisha :tada: Training link is on the onboarding checklist: https://intranet.redwood.com/onboarding/security-training — it’s two modules. For devices we prefer issuing a company laptop but we can make exceptions, tagging @Kai (security) to confirm.
Kai (Security): @Aisha welcome! Training = Secure Coding + Compliance modules, due within 7 days of start. We automatically enroll new hires in the phishing simulation pool for the quarter. For personal devices we require MDM enrollment + disk encryption, unless you request a loaner.
Aisha: Thanks — quick technical q: do I need FileVault on macOS? How do I check if it’s enabled?
Kai (Security): Yes, FileVault (full disk encryption) is required if you keep work material on a personal device. On mac run: ```fdesetup status``` — it will show "FileVault is On." If it’s Off, please enable via System Settings > Privacy & Security > FileVault.
Maya (People Ops): If you want a company machine, please fill the loaner form: https://forms.redwood.com/loaner-laptop and put "security exception" in the notes. We’ll ship a laptop within 2 business days. Also ping this thread once you submit and we’ll prioritize.
Aisha: Filed the form — thanks! Also curious about 2FA: do engineers need a physical key?
Priya (Security): For engineering and anyone accessing customer or infra systems we require SSO + a hardware 2FA (YubiKey or equivalent). We’ll create an access ticket once training is done. HSM/KMS test credentials require manager sign-off + a brief access request form.
Aisha: Great — last question: how do the phishing simulation emails look? I want to be able to spot them and not accidentally click anything risky.
security-bot: Automated message from security-bot: Phishing simulations are sent from no-reply@redwood-sim.test and include "[Redwood Simulation]" in the subject line. If you report one, you’ll get a short micro-training email. More details: https://intranet.redwood.com/security/phishing-sims :lock:
Aisha: Perfect, thanks everyone :thumbsup: I’ll complete the modules today and follow up on the loaner.
Maya (People Ops): Welcome again :smile: reach out if anything blocks you — we’ll help get you set up.
